title: Stock during a delivery delay
hook: Four units leave daily. A longer lead time changes the reorder arithmetic.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Calculate the stock on hand when ordering to cover a stated delivery delay and retain a stated reserve.

misconception: Delivery lead time has no effect on the quantity consumed before arrival.
objective: Calculate the stock on hand when ordering to cover a stated delivery delay and retain a stated reserve.

claims.text: Four units leave each day. After ordering, delivery takes three days. A must still have eight units when it arrives; B keeps no reserve. Scaled model; constant toy demand; buffer=8; no policy advice.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Lead-days=3, A=20items and B=12items. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+",["*",4,"x"],8]; B=["*",4,"x"]; x denotes Lead-days. At x=3, A=20, B=12; Transfer recall: 4×6+8=32 units on hand when ordering. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Multiply daily use by waiting days, then add the reserve. This is the stock left when ordering under the toy rule, not the quantity to buy. Real demand and delays can vary; the rule is illustrative.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+",["*",4,"x"],8]; B=["*",4,"x"]; x denotes Lead-days. At x=3, A=20, B=12; Transfer recall: 4×6+8=32 units on hand when ordering. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. The principle follows from those expressions and stated scenario limits. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: Five units leave each day and delivery takes four days after ordering. To still have six units when it arrives, how many must be on hand when you order? Correct: 26. Use during the wait (5 × 4 = 20) plus the reserve of 6 gives 26.
claims.source: Declared toy demand and delivery delay. Six days × 4 units/day consumes 24 units; to retain 8 units at arrival requires 24+8=32 units initially. This is stock on hand at ordering, not the order quantity. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md. Recall patch by learning-designer (session 2, company/reviews/lifehacks-200/recall-patch-resources.lines.txt), applied 2026-10-14 by demo-builder; c4 restates the new recall item. FC LH-4 (2026-10-14, fact-checker, W-380): verified (recall): meta.json recall, resource-specs.json recall and this claim match the patch line; 5×4 = 20 used during the wait + 6 reserve = 26; option 2 only. Re-computed in node. Record: company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH4-2026-10-14.md.
